# Find Answer for Customer Query
Writes a reply to an incoming email: answers questions from the knowledge base or replies to greetings.
## When to use
- After an email has been parsed into name, email, content and type.
## How it works
1. Reads the parameters the LLM filled in for this step. 2. For `question` or `query`, looks up an answer from `embeddings` on the parent context and drafts the email with `agentemailanswer`. 3. Otherwise drafts a greeting with `agentemailgreeting`.
## Inputs
- `name`: Sender's name - `email`: Sender's email address - `content`: The question or message text - `email_type`: One of question, query, greetings, followup - `embeddings`: Embedded document ids to search, from the parent context
## Outputs
- `reply_subject`, `reply_body`, `answer`, `query`
## Implementation
- Bean `questionManagerSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.QuestionManagerSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent`
